snippet.title: Bomberman Max: Blue Champion Playthrough
snippet.description:
Playthrough of Bomberman Max: Blue Champion for the Gameboy Color. 


Note: If i'm not mistaken, to get the full ending of the game, you have to complete Bomberman Max: Red Challenger as well.
